text:
ashley: Quick update — we need to shift tomorrow's embeddings maintenance window by +2h. New window 02:00-03:30 UTC to avoid overlap with another region's drain. tagging @sre-oncall @support-lead for visibility.

IncidentBot: Scheduled maintenance created: MNT-2026-1123 (embeddings: KV compaction). ETA 02:00-03:30 UTC. Notifications queued.

sre-oncall: Ack. I'll be on the bridge during the window. Please include monitoring checks below in the status page draft.

ashley: Draft status page text attached — please review: 
```
Status: Maintenance (full notice)
Component: Embeddings service (indexing/kv compaction)
When: 02:00 - 03:30 UTC
Expected impact: Brief increase in embedding request latency during compaction. No request loss expected. If metrics exceed thresholds we will abort and rollback.
What we're doing: Running KV compaction on a subset of nodes to reduce memory and improve long-term latency.
Contact: support@redwood.ai | status.redwood.ai
```

support-lead: Wording request — change "No request loss expected" -> "No request loss expected, but customers may see transient latency spikes". Also add link to customer support doc and escalation contact.

ben: Mitigation plan: we'll run compaction with --throttle=0.3 and live monitor p95/p99 latency + embedding error rate. Abort criteria: p99 > 800ms sustained for 2m OR error rate > 0.5%. If aborted, rollback to pre-compaction snapshot. I'll push the command to the runbook.

dmitry: Can we add a short customer-facing blurb for email? Suggested: 
"We will perform a routine compaction of our embeddings index on DATE at 02:00 UTC. You might experience short-lived increases in embedding latency; service requests and data integrity will not be affected. Reach out to support@redwood.ai if you see persistent issues."

marketing: That blurb looks good, please include a one-line subject: "Notice: Brief maintenance for embeddings service (02:00 UTC)". Also add an opt-in banner for enterprise customers that want earlier notice.

sre-oncall: Monitoring checklist I will watch on the bridge: 
- status.redwood.ai component health
- p50/p95/p99 embedding latency dashboards (region + global)
- embedding error rate and 5xxs
- queue depth and compaction progress metric
I'll post an announce when we start and when we finish.

ashley: Customer email template (final): 
```
Subject: Notice: Brief maintenance for embeddings service (02:00 UTC)
Body:
Hi —
We'll run a routine compaction on our embeddings index on DATE from 02:00-03:30 UTC. You may see short-lived increases in embedding latency during the window. No data loss is expected. If you experience persistent issues, contact support@redwood.ai.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

support-lead: Added escalation contacts and the enterprise opt-in to the mailing list. Also prepping canned response for Support queue.

ben: Pushing runbook + abort command now to the ops repo. Snippet: 
```bash
redwood-ops compaction start --subset embeddings-hot --throttle 0.3 --notify incident-bot:MNT-2026-1123
# abort: redwood-ops compaction abort --id <run-id>
```

IncidentBot: MNT-2026-1123 status updated to: SCHEDULED -> STARTING (02:00 UTC). Oncall: @sre-oncall, Support: @support-lead.

sre-oncall: Starting compaction now (02:02 UTC). Joining bridge. Will update every 10 minutes or on threshold.

ashley: Posting status page live update: "Maintenance in progress — embeddings compaction underway. Users may see transient latency increases." :loudspeaker:

marketing: Published customer email at 02:05 UTC. Link to sent copy: https://mk.example.com/emb-2026-02

sre-oncall: Compaction progressing, 45% complete. p99 at 420ms, error rate stable <0.1%. No abort.

ben: Throttle reduced to 0.25 to reduce tail latencies.

sre-oncall: 100% complete. No persistent errors observed. Rolling post-maint checks for 20m.

IncidentBot: MNT-2026-1123 status updated: COMPLETED. Duration: 00:58:40.

ashley: Maintenance complete — updating status page + customer follow-up. Proposed completion message: 
"Maintenance complete: Embeddings compaction finished successfully at 03:00 UTC. If you observe any issues, please contact support@redwood.ai."

support-lead: Will send a customer follow-up note and tag enterprise accounts we flagged.

dmitry: Adding postmortem checklist entry: compaction telemetry, threshold tuning, opt-in scheduling for enterprise.

marketing: Thx — sending final status to customers now.

ashley: Closing thread. Great coordination, team. :clap:
